entries.title: RxMER playback needs a longer run
entries.faq_heading: RxMER playback needs a longer run
entries.summary: The last RxMER capture transition must fit inside the source observation window.
entries.context: Final transition: {final_transition_ms} ms (symbol {final_transition_symbol}). Current duration: {current_duration_ms} ms.
entries.suggestion: Set Configure WorkBench → Run → Duration per Profile to at least {minimum_duration_ms} ms, or reduce OFDM symbols between captures / the capture count.
entries.over_limit_suggestion: This sequence needs at least {minimum_duration_ms} ms, above the {maximum_duration_ms} ms duration limit. Reduce OFDM symbols between captures / the capture count, or use Single capture / Average mode.
entries.note: Increasing the active run budget does not extend the observation window.

entries.title: QAM profile has no retained result
entries.faq_heading: QAM profile has no retained result
entries.summary: Imported profile IDs are separate from completed simulation results.
entries.suggestion: In Configure WorkBench, select the desired profiles, apply the configuration and run them. Wait for the selected run to complete, then choose its Run Profile in the analyzer.
entries.note: Opening a WB does not run it. Start or accepted input changes clear transient results. Missing results never use another profile’s samples.

entries.title: MCE settings are outside supported limits
entries.faq_heading: MCE settings are outside supported limits
entries.summary: MCE needs finite receiver policies with bounded work.
entries.suggestion: Set averaging to 1–128 symbols. In Rust/CLI requests use a variance floor from 1e-12 to 1.
entries.note: MCE is pilot-assisted and retains explicit bootstrap timing assumptions; a ready history is not an accuracy guarantee.

entries.title: MCE could not estimate a usable channel
entries.faq_heading: MCE could not estimate a usable channel
entries.summary: The receiver could not continue with valid received pilot estimates or bounded correction.
entries.suggestion: Review channel noise, echo strength and pilot coverage. Try a weaker impairment or compare with supplied-H reference correction; MCE never falls back automatically.
entries.note: MCE is pilot-assisted and retains explicit bootstrap timing assumptions; a ready history is not an accuracy guarantee.

entries.title: Waveform channel settings are unsupported
entries.summary: The selected waveform filter does not meet the supported bounds or response-source policy.
entries.suggestion: Use at most 2048 samples of memory. Synthetic echoes require Flat / unity input; Tilt / Cable Loss can be applied before the echo filter. Use the per-subcarrier model for unsupported combinations.
entries.note: Continuous filtering preserves history between symbols. A CM capture does not uniquely establish absolute propagation delay.

entries.title: CM waveform filter does not match the capture
entries.faq_heading: CM waveform filter does not match the capture
entries.summary: The finite causal filter exceeds the declared complex-response approximation errors.
entries.suggestion: Keep the per-subcarrier model, or review maximum delay and causal shift in Echo / Delay. Do not increase fit tolerances simply to hide a poor reconstruction.
entries.note: Continuous filtering preserves history between symbols. A CM capture does not uniquely establish absolute propagation delay.

entries.title: RxMER Designer recipe is outside supported limits
entries.faq_heading: RxMER Designer recipe is outside supported limits
entries.summary: The Designer requires bounded frequency and capture ranges and finite MER edits.
entries.suggestion: Check one-based inclusive capture ranges, exact carrier-center frequencies for value edits, and notch width inside the source band. Reduce effect depths when combined MER exceeds the supported range.
entries.note: Designed MER must stay within -30 to 120 dB. No clipping or changes to original inputs occur.
